metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: MITRE T1687: Exploitation for Defense Impairment
properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1687 (Exploitation for Defense Impairment). Adversaries may exploit vulnerabilities in security software, infrastructure, or defensive components to degrade, disable, or otherwise continue to impair their ability to prevent, detect, or respond
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1687" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-027
